correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact diametral pairs are finite ordered vertex pairs; for every nonzero inward vertex tangent direction the diameter unit vector has strictly positive pairing. Consequently local cone products have compact L_ab<=1 slices and near-maximal pairs are O(epsilon) from their vertices. The exact squared-distance boundary L<1+epsilon/(2D)(||v-u||^2-1) yields a uniform radial threshold and coefficient d*k_ab*m_ab/D after product-cone beta integration; m_ab is positive transverse quadratic moment. Homogeneous cone depths give Dirichlet(d,d,1), simple-cone ray coefficients give Dirichlet(1,...,1), and O(epsilon) symmetric-difference yields total variation. For boxes, m_ab=3D^2 sum 1/a_i^2/[d(2d+1)]-1; the announced second coefficient and fixed-volume cube leading minimizer follow. Verified algebra against two earlier full source proofs; no need to infer infinity from finite samples.
